title: Glitched
overview: Set against a world of super spies and bad guys, Glitched is a non-stop action and full on comedy about mistaken identity. "Billy Speckle", a tech-geek accountant thinks that he's found the girl of his dreams in a shady Internet chat site. Under gunfire and on the other end of the line is government spy "Black Cat" who thinks that she's found her newly assigned contact. When she relays him a top secret package she's stolen, Ziel, the leader of a powerful and subversive organization, is on to Billy and will stop at nothing to get it back. Now Billy and Black Cat are the only ones that stand between the package, and the nation's security!
